text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Tap, is that how you run!?
Is that your all!? No way it is!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Know yourself! Push to your limits!
Keep going, keep going, keep going!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Even more from here!?

What Katsuragi Ace taught me was
"to throw away counter-strategies and
just focus completely on your own running."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Listen up. Pace-chasers, betwixt, and closers are inevitably affected by the pace around them.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Especially in bigger races, there are times when everyone glares at each other, locking horns and slowing to a crawl.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's the weakness of someone "who has it all".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Weakness? Of the one who has it?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Those who have something are afraid to lose it.
They run trying not to lose it, but—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That in itself is the "trap."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"If you want to blow the world away,
you won't get there by playing it safe."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Single-mindedly polish your own race and see it through to the end.
The moment you start reading the room, you've already lost.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you get it?

It was vague, but I could relate.
I'm also the type to build a race around the accumulation of numbers.

"If you're swayed by race developments, you'll never achieve consistent victory.
You must be able to run at your absolute limit at all times."
choice_data_list: Tap. Let's check the clock again, one more time

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"A stopwatch...
Are you looking for the best lap time?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay. It was never my style
to change how I act
just based on whose face I'm looking at anyway."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's master it, Trainer.
Our running, paced down to the exact split second.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Time to break our own record!
Let's surpass who we are right now!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Trainer, Ace...
Is this her...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we've finally reached it. Pushing to the absolute limit,
easing off just before the edge, and exploding forward again from there.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The pace Trainer tuned is perfect too. If I can run like this—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"We can set the world ablaze.
Without a shadow of a doubt!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I see! Thanks, Ace!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's complete.
Our running style, that is.
choice_data_list: Yeah, no more mind games needed.
Yeah, we don't need to play games anymore.

text_block_list.text:
The ultimate form—combining Tap Dance City's
limits with the best possible pace I calculated.
Having received the stamp of approval from the one she admired, Tap Dance City's running was finally perfected.
And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence.
What are the odds? This is almost like—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's just like that day!
Everything about it…… is exactly like what I saw on TV that day!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "The race is the Japan Cup. And—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And standing in our way is the very same,
mightiest Symboli of them all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What's up?
How are you feeling, Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Not bad.
I'll be counting on you today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, I'd love to indulge you,
but I don't think I can keep you company today.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I have to run
against the world, after all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The world...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. Just beating you isn't enough!
Even an overwhelming victory isn't enough!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A run that goes beyond even that, one that takes the world's breath away!
That's what I desperately want to show my benefactor!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, they'll never reach. These fingers, reaching for the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And to the treasure of everlasting smiles
that I'm aiming for, too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Puzzling. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Very well.
I shall aim for my own goal."
(WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: Don't lose... Hang in there, Tap-kun!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Do it... show 'em what you've got!

I watched alongside Katsuragi Ace and the others.
What was at stake today was...
whether they could recreate that legendary race.

Inheriting Katsuragi Ace's running and claiming the ultimate victory is the true payback.
And when that happens, the canal to the world will open once again.
